seo.title: Split Easy — Bill Splitting App for iOS
seo.description: Split Easy makes group expense splits fast and fair. Add people, totals, and tips, then share results instantly without manual spreadsheet work.

hero.label: Split Bills, Keep Friends
hero.title: Split quickly with your group. No awkward math.
text: Split Easy makes group expense splits fast and fair. Add people, totals, and tips, then share results instantly without manual spreadsheet work.

items.title: Fast split calculation
items.text: Totals, tips, tax, and participant shares are resolved in one quick flow.

items.title: Uneven split support
items.text: Different share amounts are easy to configure for shared expenses where shares are not equal.

items.title: Share results instantly
items.text: Create a clean result card and send it to everyone in your group with one action.

items.title: History and templates
items.text: Revisit prior checks quickly and reuse common splits for recurring trips or routines.

items.title: Home screen visibility
items.text: Widgets and quick actions make frequent use in restaurants, travel, and events friction-free.

sections.title: Privacy
text: Split Easy never requires an account or cloud profile. Entries stay local, and no data is sold, shared, or used for analytics.

cta.title: Ready to start?
cta.text: Install Split Easy to track smarter and stay focused on what matters.
